integrity_notes: Proof includes exact companion-matrix identities, all-index binomial valuation bound, and finite residue-class counting. Standalone Python checker reproduces critical finite computations. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only binary valuations of shifted Narayana numbers, not valuations of unshifted terms, shifts by minus one, or other primes. Exact priority against unindexed literature is unverified.
title: Exact binary valuations of shifted Narayana numbers and a sharp counting law
